name: Medium Purple
lede: Medium Purple is a soft, blue-leaning purple from the named colors of the web.

sections.title: A web color
sections.body:
Paterson lists MediumPurple as one of the colours in the X11 Color Set, with the hex code #9370DB [1]. In his index he files it among the pinkish purples, not the violets [2]. That placement differs from our own records, which put it closer to amethyst than to pink [3].

It is one of the "Medium" names that fill the middle of the X11 list: MediumSeaGreen, MediumSlateBlue, MediumSpringGreen, MediumTurquoise and MediumVioletRed come right after it [1]. The xkcd color survey uses the same words for a very different color, #9E43A2 [3]. Two lists, one name, two colors: a good reason to quote the hex code when it matters [1][3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Its chroma is 62 and its lightness 55, so it reads as a clear mid-tone purple [3]. The nearest standard name is [[amethyst]], 4.3 ΔE away [3]. Related names: [[purple]], [[medium-orchid]], [[medium-slate-blue]] and [[violet]].
